en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. The official Kyrgyz Republic–Czech Republic treaty provides a 5 per cent source-State ceiling where the beneficial owner holds at least 15 per cent of the payer’s capital and a 10 per cent ceiling in the other treaty case. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 11 — Interest. The official Kyrgyz Republic–Czech Republic treaty provides a general 5 per cent source-State ceiling where the recipient is the beneficial owner, with residence-State-only taxation for qualifying credit sales, government or central-bank cases, export or investment-promotion institutions and qualifying government-guaranteed financing. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 12 — Royalties. The official Kyrgyz Republic–Czech Republic treaty provides a 10 per cent source-State ceiling on royalties where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.
